meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或品牌元素做成几秒的动态视频短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把关键信息做成短动效视频,而不是实拍或旁白长片
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, data, or brand elements into a short motion video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a short, design-led motion clip instead of a narrated video

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会做 10 秒上下的短片头动态图形——文字动效、数字滚动、图表动画、logo 与字幕条、动画地图等,不配旁白。它自己完成取材、设计与合成,渲染前先问你要预览还是渲染,最终输出 MP4 或透明叠加层。
howto.when: 当你要求做一段 10 秒上下、没有旁白的动态图形(如文字动效、数字滚动、logo 亮相等)时接管;更长、有旁白或多场景的需求会转给 /general-video。

say.text: 做一段 5 秒的文字动效片头,文案我提供
say.note: 它会先规划镜头再合成,渲染前问你预览还是渲染

say.text: 把这组数据做成柱状图动画,数字从 0 涨上去
say.note: 归为图表类,确认后才渲染

say.text: 做一个 logo 亮相动画,logo 文件我传给你

howto.what_en: After install, Claude makes short, design-led motion graphics (~10s, no narration) like kinetic type, stat count-up or logo animation, output as MP4 or a transparent overlay. It builds on its own and asks before rendering.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a short (~10s), unnarrated motion graphic such as kinetic type, a stat count-up or a logo sting; longer, narrated or multi-scene requests are routed to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make a 5-second kinetic-type opener, I'll give the copy.
say_en.note: It plans the shot, composes, then asks preview or render.

say_en.text: Animate this dataset as a bar chart with numbers counting up from 0.
say_en.note: Bar-chart category; renders after you approve.

say_en.text: Build a logo sting animation; here's my logo file.
